summary: Completed comprehensive testing of CSV Import feature for MEDILO pharmacy management system. All 12 features tested and working correctly. Backend APIs (validate/confirm) pass all tests. Frontend UI has all required elements with correct data-testid attributes. Full import flow (Upload → Preview → Confirm → Import) works end-to-end.

issues: Minor: Console warning about missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility improvement recommended

passed_tests: 1. POST /api/ops/products/import/validate - accepts CSV file upload, validates format, returns preview with total_rows, new_entries, update_entries, errors
2. POST /api/ops/products/import/validate - rejects non-CSV files with 400 error
4. POST /api/ops/products/import/validate - reports row-level validation errors (missing fields, invalid dates, invalid numbers)
5. POST /api/ops/products/import/confirm - creates new products in DB
6. POST /api/ops/products/import/confirm - updates quantity for duplicate product+batch (adds to existing)
7. POST /api/ops/products/import/confirm - creates new entry for different batch
9. GET /api/medicines - imported products are immediately searchable
10. Frontend: Import CSV button visible on Medicines tab (data-testid='import-csv-btn')
11. Frontend: CSV Import dialog opens with 4-step flow (Upload, Preview, Confirm, Import)
12. Frontend: Drop zone for file upload (data-testid='csv-drop-zone')
17. Full E2E flow: Upload CSV → Preview validation results → Confirm → Import complete
critical_code_review_comments: Backend CSV validation correctly handles multiple date formats (YYYY-MM-DD, DD-MM-YYYY, DD/MM/YYYY)
Duplicate detection works correctly: same product+batch updates quantity, different batch creates new entry
Role-based access control properly enforced (403 for non-ops users)
Frontend uses multipart/form-data for file upload as expected
All UI elements have correct data-testid attributes for testing
Preview shows sorted data by expiry date as specified
Error handling displays validation errors clearly in the UI
seed_data_creation: Test CSV file at /tmp/test_products.csv used for testing. Backend tests create TEST_ prefixed products for isolation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CSV Import feature fully implemented and tested. Backend endpoints: POST /api/ops/products/import/validate (multipart/form-data file upload) and POST /api/ops/products/import/confirm (JSON body with rows array). Frontend has CSVImportDialog component with 4-step flow. All data-testid attributes present: import-csv-btn, csv-drop-zone, csv-file-input, csv-validate-btn, csv-proceed-btn, csv-confirm-import-btn, csv-done-btn. Test file at /tmp/test_products.csv. Required CSV headers: Product Name, Category, Type, Batch, Expiry Date, Quantity, MRP, Purchase Price, Manufacturer.
